messages:
incident-bot: PAGE P0 — routing.policy-engine PANIC detected (INC-2026-034). Error signature: policy_engine/runtime: panic: invalid memory access in rule eval
impact: elevated 5xx (~8%) and latency cross-region (~200ms tail for EU). Automatic fallback loop observed between eu-west and us-west variants. Paging oncall @amber :rotating_light:

amber: on it. I'm taking this. leaving a quick note: is anyone still on-call in eng-sre after hours?

jared: i can assist for the next hour. what's the current mitigation plan?

opsbot: stacktrace attached ->
```
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
2026-02-12T03:12:45Z policy_engine/eval.go:412 evalRule
policy: smart-fallback-v3 rule: select_variant
expression: request.modelVariant.startsWith("r-")
```

amber: aha. looks like a null deref on modelVariant. temporary mitigation: disable smart routing policy for routing-group 'customer-facing' and force pass-through to origin. can someone run the quick override?

jared: doing the override now. running curl to gateway API:
```bash
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/policies/overrides \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"target":"routing-group/customer-facing","policy":"pass-through","reason":"mitigate panic INC-2026-034"}'
```

opsbot: override applied by jared at 03:18Z. policy smart-fallback-v3 disabled for routing-group/customer-facing.

maya: monitoring — grafana link: https://grafana.internal/d/rrouting/errors?var-group=customer-facing — error rate dropped from 8.1% -> 0.9% within 2m of override. latency tail also improved. :white_check_mark:

samir: quick root cause note — the policy expression used a string method on request.modelVariant without verifying presence. when requests from older mobile SDKs omit modelVariant field, eval path dereferences nil. that triggers the panic in our interpreter. we need a guard and fuzz tests for missing attributes.

eli: can we pin model variant at edge as a stopgap? set header X-Model-Variant=r-1-small on gateway to avoid variant-selection path. planning to push a small rule in edge config.

amber: agreed. jared + eli coordinate. samir, can you prepare a safe policy patch? include defensive checks like `request.modelVariant != null && type(request.modelVariant) == "string" && startsWith(request.modelVariant, "r-")`

samir: will do. patch branch: fix/policy-null-checks, adding unit tests for absent fields. i'll open PR and request fast-track.

jared: edge pin applied at 03:25Z. verifying logs... requests from EU now route direct to primary model variant, fallback loop stopped.

opsbot: 03:28Z observed steady state. 5xx rate trending back to baseline.

amber: excellent. declaring mitigation in place. next actions: samir to submit PR for hotfix, eng-runtime to add guard in policy interpreter to avoid panics and return controlled error instead, postmortem with customer impact numbers.

maya: customer impact estimate: affected requests ~4.7k in 15m window, 3 customer orgs reported degraded responses (support tickets opened).

eli: tagging folks for on-call Hx: @oncall-sre-team for follow-up and @product-ops for customer comms.

amber: thanks all. logging incident as P0 -> INC-2026-034. i'll handoff to eli for overnight watch. eli, you're oncall for the rest of the shift.

eli: acknowledged. taking handoff — will monitor and run the rollback if any regression. please add any lingering notes to the incident doc. :clipboard:
